policy.name: Himachal Pradesh Industrial Investment Policy, 2019 and Rules Regarding Grant of Incentives, Concessions and Facilities for Investment Promotion in Himachal Pradesh-2019
policy.order_no: Dept of Industries Notification No. Ind.-A(F)2-2/2019-I dated 16-08-2019 (last extension: Notification No. IND-A(F)1-3/2024 dated 12-08-2026, two months)

zones.C: Category C - tribal areas, industrially backward development blocks and backward panchayats

zone_lookup: Policy para 6 'Categorization of State' and the area-category annexure of the 2019 notification (list of blocks/panchayats by category A/B/C); see the consolidated 'Industrial Investment Policy 2019 and Rules ... as on 14-03-2024 with all amendments' on emerginghimachal.hp.gov.in.

schemes.name: Interest Subvention on term loan (MSME) - LAPSED
schemes.notes: HISTORICAL - policy extension ran out on ~12-10-2026 and no successor notified as of 17-10-2026. Only for units that qualified while the policy was in force. 3% on term loan for 3 years from first disbursement; annual cap Rs 2/4/6 lakh in Cat A/B/C (top-level annual_cap = Cat A). Text verified against the ORIGINAL 16-08-2019 notification; later amendments (2022, Dec 2023, 2024) not checked.

schemes.name: Assistance for Technology, Competitiveness, Innovation and Quality Certification - LAPSED
schemes.notes: HISTORICAL. 50% of expenses on in-house testing facilities/equipment for BIS/WHO-GMP/ISO/organic/international certification (excluding production P&M), max Rs 5 lakh per enterprise. Original 2019 text; amendments not checked.

schemes.name: Net SGST Reimbursement - LAPSED
schemes.notes: HISTORICAL. Original 2019 text: MSMEs get 50%/80%/90% of Net SGST (Cat A/B/C) for 7 years, overall cap 80% of FCI. Marked unverified because a December 2023 amendment reportedly changed SGST reimbursement rates (TeamLease/Tribune) and the amended text could not be retrieved.

schemes.name: Assistance for ETP / rainwater harvesting (MSME) - LAPSED
schemes.notes: HISTORICAL. 25% of P&M/equipment for ETP or rainwater harvesting (excluding construction), max Rs 2 lakh; plus 50% of ETP power tariff for 3 years up to Rs 1 lakh/yr (14(b)).

other_benefits: Concessional electricity duty for 5 years (Rule 16): EHT 7%, large industrial 5%, medium 3%, small (<=50 kVA) 1%, units employing >300 Himachalis 1%; 15% lower energy charges for 3 years via HPSEBL tariff (HISTORICAL)
Stamp duty charged at 50%/30%/10% of applicable rate for MSMEs in Cat A/B/C (Rule 8) (HISTORICAL)
Transport subsidy in Cat B & C; P&M transportation 50% up to Rs 2-3 lakh; DPR 50% subsidy; NSE-SME listing 50% up to Rs 10 lakh (HISTORICAL)
No central capital-investment package for HP is open: central Industrial Development Scheme for HP & Uttarakhand 2017 ended 31-03-2022 (not re-verified here)
